thread:
Leo: Heads-up - Lighthouse AI has 9 preview seats but only 2 active users this week. Renewal conversation roughly 6 weeks after beta close. Want a low-friction re-engage plan.
Aisha: Noted. Do we know which personas are quiet?
Leo: Quiet: 3 PMs, 2 analysts, 2 data-engineers. Active: 2 backend engineers.
Tom: Suggest a two-track approach: (A) 30m "PM outcomes" session (10m) + analyst lab (15m) + 5m next steps, (B) offer 1:1 pairing for top blockers.
Vanessa: I'll draft a 2-question pulse: 1) what's the primary blocker? 2) which session do you prefer? Keep it optional and 20s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Aisha: Also propose a "starter PR" snippet we can ship: 1) example ingestion call, 2) minimal error handling. Engineers love run-ready code.
Leo: Risk = medium-high. If we don't get +3 active seats within 7 days after interventions, flag as renewal-risk and loop in AE.
Tom: Owners: Vanessa - send pulse + calendar options. Aisha - produce starter PR + sandbox snippet. I'll run the PM outcomes session and lead office hours. Leo - update playbook and set the escalation trigger.
Vanessa: Outreach draft (copy/edit):
```
Hi Lighthouse team - quick check: we noticed some teammates haven't had a chance to try the preview. Would a short 30m session (10m outcomes + 15m hands-on) or a 1:1 pairing be most helpful? Pick a time here: <cal.link/lighthouse-30m>
```
Aisha: Starter PR plan: add /examples/lighthouse/quickstart.py, include small payload + retry logic. Will drop into #cs-code in 2 hours.
Tom: Office hours agenda: 1) goals (2m), 2) quick demo (8m), 3) guided lab (15m), 4) next steps & pairing sign-up (5m).
calendar-bot: Tentative event created: "Lighthouse - Preview Enablement" Fri 11:00-11:30 PT 3 invites pending.
Vanessa: Pulse sent. Included optional checkbox to request 1:1 pairing and a free-text blocker field.
Leo: Playbook template to paste after session:
```
Outcome: attended / no-show / follow-up scheduled
Active seats after session: (n)
Top blockers surfaced: (list)
Success metric: (e.g., 4 active users within 7 days)
Escalation: AE + eng pairing if not met
Owner + due date:
```
Aisha: Shared starter PR in #cs-code. Also added a tiny Dockerfile for local testing.
Tom: Buyer replied - prefers Tues 9am. Can we move?
Vanessa: I rescheduled to Tues 9am and sent a reminder 24h before.
Leo: Good work. If the session doesn't move the needle we'll schedule a scoped 2-hour pairing to implement a Lighthouse ingest pipeline snippet. Tagging for AE escalation if metric not met.
Tom: I'll capture attendees and drop meeting notes into the playbook after the session.
Vanessa: Will follow up with a short post-session survey (1 question) to capture immediate blockers.
Leo: Thanks team 3 tight follow-up. :white_check_mark:
